dialogues.speaker: Pahua
dialogues.text: Exactly what I said. I'm a fitness coach too, and I've got an eye for my customers' skill levels and needs.

dialogues.speaker: Pahua
dialogues.text: I only recommend equipment that I think will help, and you strike me as being a cut above the average fitness fanatic, am I right? Nothing I have here is going to challenge you enough.

dialogues.speaker: Pahua
dialogues.text: However, if you're looking to buy something for a friend, maybe I can help. Just fill me in on their physical condition they're in, and I'll do the rest.
